repo_notes.content: cjchanh is the GitHub profile README repository for CJ Chanhnourack, founder of Centennial Defense Systems (Colorado Springs). The README is the public-facing profile surface; its governing discipline is 'every product ships with a way to verify the claim: a hash to check, a verifier to run, a ledger to recompute.' It lists shippable products (Archivist Sort with printed SHA-256 and quarantine-and-rollback safety model), the AAAP Challenge (public attestation format with 54 commissioned attack cases), three public kernels (Deponent, Sworn, fleet-watch), an 'Outside check' red-team section, and an explicit 'What I will and will not claim' policy.
repo_notes.author: Devin

repo_notes.content: Layout is minimal (6 tracked files): README.md is the whole profile surface; docs/redteam-2026-09-05.md is the outside red-team report of the public surface; .githooks/ contains pre-commit, commit-msg, and attribution-patterns.txt enforcing claim/attribution hygiene on commits. There is no code, build, or CI — documentation should focus on content structure and the claims discipline, not invent infrastructure.
repo_notes.author: Devin

repo_notes.content: Vocabulary: verification-first claims, AAAP challenge, quarantine-and-rollback (recovery-not-prevention safety model), tamper-evident vs tamper-proof, red-team finding IDs D-1/C1/F-1/F-2/L-1 with closing commits. First-class sources: README.md and docs/redteam-2026-09-05.md only.
repo_notes.author: Devin
